dependency_text: The real signed preparation and its benchmark tables, the parity growth law and its fixtures, and the commit-order controls of the growth sign-law test.
objective: Add one rule, that swapping the listed order of two distinctions that both hold 1 costs a factor s (s = -1, control s = +1), and ask whether the growth law's own freedom over the commit order of a round's children supplies the sign that the three-detector experiment needs with the two real readings held fixed. Primary observable: the relabelling-proof product <ZZZ><XXZ><XZX><ZXX>, which is -1 for the quantum table and +1 for any list of local answers. Test both readings of order freedom (orders recorded, orders summed). Stop when the product follows from growth reorderings plus the one rule with nothing else supplied but the free settings, or name what must still be supplied. Serves G5 and G9.
stop_rule: Stop when the product follows from growth reorderings plus the single swap rule, or when the remaining supplied item is named.
title: Is the sign the cost of reordering?
